verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents Experiment APIs to 'manage flags, experiments, and deployments from CI, scripts, or your own tools' (amplitude-docs-13, amplitude-docs-19, amplitude-docs-35), which supports programmatic flag creation/targeting/toggling. However, the official MCP server (amplitude-docs-11/17/34, amplitude-probe-4) is described only as bringing behavioral analytics context/Q&A into AI tools like Claude/Cursor, not as a flag-management interface — no evidence an agent can create or toggle flags via MCP. Missing for 10: explicit MCP tool/endpoint for flag CRUD or toggling, and any hands-on confirmation that an agent can perform flag operations through either API or MCP.
